The Triplet of What is to be Abandoned by Seeing (Dassanena-pahātabba-ttika).
Section on Analysis:
Root Condition.

Dependent on a state that is to be abandoned by seeing, there arises a state that is to be abandoned by seeing, by way of root condition: dependent on one aggregate to be abandoned by seeing, three aggregates arise … pe … dependent on two aggregates, two aggregates arise.

Dependent on a state to be abandoned by seeing (*dassanena pahātabba*), a state that is neither to be abandoned by seeing nor by cultivation (*nevadassanena-nabhāvanāya pahātabba*) arises by way of the root condition (*hetupaccaya*): dependent on the aggregates to be abandoned by seeing, mind-originated matter (*cittasamuṭṭhāna-rūpa*) arises.
Dependent on a state to be abandoned by seeing, states both to be abandoned by seeing and neither to be abandoned by seeing nor by cultivation arise by way of the root condition:
dependent on one aggregate to be abandoned by seeing... [the remaining aggregates and mind-originated matter arise].
Three aggregates and mind-produced matter … dependent on two aggregates, two aggregates and mind-produced matter arise.

Dependent on a state eradicated by cultivation, a state eradicated by cultivation arises by way of root condition: dependent on one aggregate eradicated by cultivation, three aggregates arise … dependent on two aggregates, two aggregates arise.

Dependent on a state to be abandoned by cultivation (*bhāvanāya pahātabba*), a state that is neither to be abandoned by vision nor by cultivation arises by way of the root condition (*hetupaccaya*): dependent on the aggregates to be abandoned by cultivation, mind-originated matter (*cittasamuṭṭhāna-rūpa*) arises.

Dependent on a state to be abandoned by cultivation, states both to be abandoned by cultivation and neither to be abandoned by vision nor by cultivation arise by way of the root condition: dependent on one aggregate to be abandoned by cultivation...
Three aggregates and mind-produced matter … dependent on two aggregates, two aggregates and mind-produced matter arise.
Dependent on a state not to be abandoned by either vision or cultivation, a state not to be abandoned by either vision or cultivation arises by way of root condition:
dependent on one aggregate not to be abandoned by either vision or cultivation, [the other three aggregates and mind-produced matter arise].
Three aggregates and mind-produced matter … dependent on two aggregates, two aggregates and mind-produced matter.
At the moment of rebirth-linking, dependent on one aggregate eradicated neither by vision nor by cultivation,
three aggregates and kamma-produced matter … dependent on two aggregates, two aggregates and kamma-produced matter.
Dependent on the aggregates (khandhas), there is the physical basis (vatthu); dependent on the physical basis, there are the aggregates.

Dependent on one great primary element (mahābhūta), there are three great primary elements …pe… dependent on two great primary elements, there are two great primary elements. Dependent on the great primary elements, there is mind-produced matter (cittasamuṭṭhāna-rūpa), kamma-born matter (kaṭattā-rūpa), and derived matter (upādā-rūpa).

there arises a state that is neither to be abandoned by seeing nor by cultivation, by way of the root condition:
dependent on aggregates to be abandoned by seeing and the great primary elements, mind-produced matter arises.
Dependent on a state that is to be abandoned by cultivation and a state that is neither to be abandoned by vision nor by cultivation,
there arises a state that is neither to be abandoned by vision nor by cultivation, by way of the root condition:
dependent on aggregates to be abandoned by cultivation and the great primary elements, mind-originated matter arises.
Dependent on a state that is to be abandoned by seeing, through the condition of object (ārammaṇapaccaya), there arises a state that is to be abandoned by seeing:
dependent on one aggregate to be abandoned by seeing, three aggregates arise; ... pe ... dependent on two aggregates, two aggregates arise.

1.9.1.2. Negative Conditionality (Paccayapaccanīya)
Section on Analysis (Vibhaṅgavāra):

Dependent on a state eradicated by vision, a state eradicated by vision arises by way of the root-condition (na-hetu-paccaya)— dependent on the aggregates associated with doubt, delusion associated with doubt arises.

Dependent on a state to be abandoned by cultivation, a state to be abandoned by cultivation arises by way of the not-root condition: dependent on the restlessness-accompanied aggregates, restlessness-accompanied delusion arises.

Dependent on a state to be abandoned neither by vision nor by cultivation, a state to be abandoned neither by vision nor by cultivation arises by way of the not-root condition: one rootless [state] to be abandoned neither by vision nor by cultivation...
Dependent on one aggregate, arise three aggregates and mind-produced matter … dependent on two aggregates … At the moment of rootless rebirth-linking,
dependent on one aggregate to be abandoned neither by vision nor by cultivation,
arise three aggregates and kamma-produced matter … dependent on two aggregates, arise two aggregates … dependent on aggregates, [arise aggregates].
The basis; depending on the basis, the aggregates [arise]; depending on one great primary element, three great primary elements [arise] ...pe...
depending on the great primary elements, mind-originated matter, kamma-born matter, and derived matter [arise]; external ... nutriment-originated ... temperature-originated ...
in the case of non-percipient beings, depending on one great primary element, three great primary elements [arise] ...pe... depending on the great primary elements.
Dependent on derived matter produced by past kamma, there is derived matter.

Dependent on a state that is to be abandoned by seeing, a state that is neither to be abandoned by seeing nor by cultivation arises by way of the condition of not-object: dependent on aggregates to be abandoned by seeing, there is mind-originated matter.

Dependent on a state eradicated by cultivation (*bhāvanāya pahātabba*), a state that is neither eradicated by vision nor by cultivation arises by way of the object-condition (*ārammaṇapaccaya*): dependent on the aggregates eradicated by cultivation, mind-produced matter (*cittasamuṭṭhāna-rūpa*) arises.

Dependent on a state that is neither eradicated by vision nor by cultivation, a state that is neither eradicated by vision nor by cultivation arises by way of the object-condition: dependent on the aggregates that are neither eradicated by vision nor by cultivation... [arises].
Matter produced by mind: at the moment of rebirth-linking, depending on the aggregates that are to be abandoned neither by vision nor by cultivation, there is kamma-produced matter;

depending on the aggregates, there is the [heart-]base; one great primary element … external … nutriment-produced … temperature-produced … one great primary element of non-percipient beings … and so forth.
Dependent on states that are to be abandoned by vision and states that are neither to be abandoned by vision nor by cultivation,
there arises a state that is neither to be abandoned by vision nor by cultivation, by way of object-condition:
dependent on the aggregates to be abandoned by vision and the great primary elements, mind-produced matter arises.
Dependent on a state that is to be abandoned by cultivation and a state that is neither to be abandoned by vision nor by cultivation,
there arises a state that is neither to be abandoned by vision nor by cultivation by way of the object-condition:
dependent on aggregates to be abandoned by cultivation and the great primaries, mind-produced matter arises.

Dependent on a state to be abandoned by vision, a state to be abandoned by vision arises by way of the non-predominance condition … (complete as for the root condition) … by way of the non-proximity condition … by way of the non-contiguity condition … by way of the non-mutuality condition.
